name: Voldaren Manor
description: Site of Olivia's wedding and the Gatewatch raid.

description_citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
timeline.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
timeline.quote: I have a little something else planned first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A cage draped in red descends from the ceiling, and Sorin recalls being forced by his grandfather to drink angel blood.
timeline.quote: a familiar scent comes to him—angel blood.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
timeline.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
timeline.quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
timeline.quote: A blade of red-black slices through the chains as easily as any sword.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin fights through the guards and seizes a gold-encrusted sword to kill Olivia.
timeline.quote: Three more fall in quick succession, crushed beneath the weight of the new weapon.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A flash of light throws off Sorin's cut, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: Grasping for the now-falling key, Olivia is furious.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.
timeline.quote: this is someone's spirit, separated from their body.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
timeline.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Outside, Chandra and Adeline see golden light and the invitation wards crumbling.
timeline.quote: The invitation wards are crumbling.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A beam of light shatters Voldaren Manor's windows and the invitation wards crumble, and Arlinn orders the assault.
timeline.quote: she shouts to the others, "Now!"

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Teferi burn down the manor's great door, beginning the assault proper.
timeline.quote: soon the door before them is only ash

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya senses angry spirits and hears Katilda calling, and goes to free the geists while Arlinn presses on.
timeline.quote: "I'll see about our backup. It's time the Voldarens paid their debts."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The assault force tears through the guards and furnishings of the manor.
timeline.quote: Vampires built this place on the backs of mortals.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn reaches the ballroom, sees Sigarda reaping vampires, and spares a Markov duelist rather than kill him as Tovolar would.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hefts him overhead and hurls him into a column.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Cathars crash through the windows and the crowd demands the key; Olivia rages at the destruction of her wedding.
timeline.quote: "You . . . all of you! You're ruining my wedding day !"

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of geists materialize and attack their former oppressors, led by Katilda.
timeline.quote: There must be hundreds of them, all materializing at once

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya stabs Olivia's train, freeing the geists bound within it, and Olivia flees into a hallway.
timeline.quote: Kaya plunges a spectral dagger into Olivia's fell train.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn chases Olivia through the portrait-lined corridors and corners her in a dead end, where she claws her.
timeline.quote: With a human howl, she lashes out

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts Arlinn's fingers and stabs her chest with a gilt sword, taunting her for being alone.
timeline.quote: "You're all alone here."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn changes into her wolf form and fights Olivia, hurling her through a statue.
timeline.quote: Senses sharpen. Strength returns to her as she grows

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Distracted by tearing at the portraits, Arlinn is staked by Olivia from behind and falls.
timeline.quote: How ironic—a vampire's stiffened hand makes for an excellent stake.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia charms Edgar with her blood so he agrees to marry her, planning to control Innistrad's angels with Sigarda's blood.
timeline.quote: Olivia used her blood to wake Edgar from his sleep and, in doing so, managed to charm him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks during the wedding; Katilda frees Sigarda, whose outburst shatters the glass and wounds guests.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch raids the manor; Olivia flees and impales Arlinn.
timeline.quote: Sigarda's outburst lowered the wards around Voldaren Manor, allowing the Gatewatch to begin their raid.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escapes with Edgar.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar through one of the broken windows.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
timeline.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya points Tovolar to the door where Arlinn went, and he bounds toward her.
timeline.quote: Tovolar's gone the second she's done talking

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin spares Edgar's life and tells him to get out of his sight; Edgar flees.
timeline.quote: Sorin scowls. "Go. Get out of my sight."

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn dreams of forests and wakes to find Tovolar and her four wolves around her.
timeline.quote: When she opens her eyes, Tovolar is the first thing she sees

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Tovolar their grievance is unsettled and he proposes that they settle it afterward.
timeline.quote: "Tovolar," she says, "this doesn't change anything between us.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her wolves track Olivia and corner her with Edgar, and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees.
timeline.quote: But she drops the key.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn takes the key in her teeth and tells Tovolar to come find her later.
timeline.quote: Arlinn wraps the key with a length of torn curtain and picks it up between her teeth.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

relations.quote: The air in Stensia is bright and clear for the first time in what feels like months

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.
